name: SpokAnthro
description: SpokAnthro was a furry convention in Spokane, Washington, organized by the RAIn Board. It was founded in November 2017 by former chairman Lemnius Gryphs, vice chairman Syberwolf and former All Fur Fun chairman Moorcat, and its mascot is a river otter named Slate. The inaugural convention, "The Ancient Lands", was held August 23 to 25, 2019, and was the first furry convention in Spokane since All Fur Fun in 2009. The 2020 convention was cancelled during the COVID-19 pandemic, a "Circus of Fluff" edition was postponed to 2022, and the convention is currently on indefinite hiatus.
